methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible (2026-06-15). Akamai/Linode: linode.com/pricing redirects to akamai.com/cloud/pricing; Shared CPU prices confirmed from official page. Vultr: official vultr.com/pricing page confirmed plan tiers and prices. DigitalOcean: official digitalocean.com/pricing/droplets page confirmed Basic Droplet tiers. OVHcloud: official ovhcloud.com/en/vps/ confirmed VPS 2027 plan prices — listed prices reflect the annual (upfront-12-month) billing cycle; no separate month-to-month USD rate was published on page. Hetzner Cloud: official hetzner.com/cloud page is JavaScript-rendered and returned only placeholder text. On adversarial re-verification (2026-06-17) the prior vpsbenchmarks-derived USD figures did not reconcile with two concordant independent sources (bitdoze.com, betterstack.com) reporting post-1-Apr-2026 EUR prices (CX23 €3.99, CX43 €11.99, CPX22 €7.99, CAX11 €4.49; CCX13 €12.49–15.99 — sources conflict), and a further Hetzner price adjustment took effect 15 Jun 2026. All Hetzner plan monthlyUsd values therefore set to null with per-plan notes; no USD price asserted. Kamatera: official kamatera.com/pricing page returned three preset plan tiers (Basic/Standard/Pro); deeper plan matrix sourced from vpsbenchmarks.com (Availability and General Purpose families). Hostinger: official hostinger.com/vps-hosting page confirmed KVM plan promotional pricing on 2-year term. minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overagePerMin/overagePerCall = null on all plans (non-telephony vertical). Only representative entry-level and mid-tier plans recorded per vendor to keep dataset actionable; higher tiers noted in methodologyNotes. hipaa/baa/bilingual null unless explicitly stated on pricing page. annualDiscountPct null unless both monthly and annual rates were explicitly published.
